record.notes: Исследуемое следствие §36: если всю жизнь влечений и органические функции удастся объяснить из воли к власти, действующую силу и мир, рассматриваемый изнутри, можно будет так определить. Запись не отбрасывает условия и не утверждает, что они выполнены.
record.preferred_label: Если редукция удастся, мир изнутри — воля к власти: JGB 36

semantic_content.assertion_force: Conditional consequence under examination; explanatory success is not established.
semantic_content.proposition: If the whole life of drives and all organic functions can be explained from will to power as one basic form of will, the world considered from within could be characterized as will to power.

semantic_scope.identity_criterion: Retain the proposition while its antecedents and consequent remain the final conditional in this passage; asserting the antecedents or an unconditional consequence requires distinct judgments.
semantic_scope.scope_note: The final conditional consequence of JGB 36, separate from the opening supposition and from admission of either.

variant_labels.value: If the reductions succeed, the world from within is will to power — JGB 36
